o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (pišik), from Proto-Common Turkic *pišik.
From Proto-Turkic *büt-, whence also bütün (“all, whole”). Cognate with Turkish bitmek, Chuvash пӗт (pĕt) etc.
By surface analysis, öz + fəaliyyət, literally “self-activity”. Calque of Russian самоде́ятельность (samodéjatelʹnostʹ).
